Thanks for the ping, Markus — I dug into the log Lena attached. Short technical note: the failure is coming from an unexpected nested attribute (emailAliases) that the EdgeScale IdP emits when a user has multiple addresses; our SAML mapper currently expects a string and not an array. The fix is small but their CI tests are strict and will need a couple of integration cycles.

Estimate: 2–3 dev days to implement the mapper change + 5–7 days for EdgeScale's internal QA and deployment. Realistically, 2–3 weeks to account for release windows — aligns with what Lena said.

Workaround option: we can create a console-level attribute alias that flattens to a single principal for staging only; that would let them complete end-to-end QA within 72 hours. If EdgeScale agrees to that, the credits needed drop substantially — I would recommend a 30-day trial extension + 1200 USD sandbox credit. If they need the full-traffic path patched, approve up to 1500 USD and 30 days.

I've attached a terse error_trace.log with the stack snapshot and included a sample mapping script we can drop into staging (attachment: error_trace.log). Happy to jump on a quick troubleshooting call with their engineers.

— Soojin Lee
